limitations: All inputs are existing approved garments already fitted to these bodies. Free exact overlay is the zero-cost control.
Golden-mask differences can be valid drape; palette/edge/shape metrics do not supply independent semantic ownership or prove motif preservation.
Raw key-colored witnesses and off-key extraction cannot classify every pixel as body or gear.
No image translation, resizing, pose correction, palette matching, best-frame selection, postprocessing or paid rerun is used.
Only one requested seed per fixture/view and one provider call per arm. Equal seeds do not establish shared stochastic noise.
Output cardinality deviates from the predeclared protocol for every request; endpoint sensitivity does not retroactively repair protocol conformity.
